title: Server-side fetch with a computed URL in go — review required
description: net/http is called with a URL assembled at runtime rather than a literal. When any part of that URL comes from a request, the server can be steered to internal services, cloud metadata endpoints, or arbitrary hosts. The rule flags the non-literal call; whether the URL is attacker-influenced is a review decision.
remediation: Resolve the destination against an allowlist of hosts and schemes, reject private and link-local address ranges after DNS resolution, and never pass request text directly to net/http.
limitation: Lexical: matches http.Get/Post/Head with a non-literal argument; URLs built in a helper are out of scope.
